# Fizz Kidz

Fizz Kidz is an Australian kids entertainment and education business based in Melbourne, Victoria. Fizz Kidz runs creative kids birthday parties, school holiday programs, preschool programs, school science incursions, kids event activations and corporate or community children's workshops.

Website: https://www.fizzkidz.com.au/
Phone: +61 3 9059 8144
Email: bookings@fizzkidz.com.au
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/fizzkidzz/

## Key Services

- Kids birthday parties in Melbourne: creative, hands-on parties for children aged 4 to 12. Party themes include slime, science, glam, fairy, safari, unicorn, tie dye, Swiftie, K-Pop Demon Hunters and Fluid Bears. Main page: https://www.fizzkidz.com.au/birthday-parties/
- Slime birthday parties in Melbourne: hands-on slime parties where children customise slime and take their creations home. Page: https://www.fizzkidz.com.au/birthday-parties/slime-parties/
- School holiday programs in Melbourne: creative holiday programs for children aged 4 to 12, available at Fizz Kidz studios. Page: https://www.fizzkidz.com.au/holiday-programs/
- Preschool Program: drop-off preschool program for children aged 2.5 to 5 years focused on confidence, creativity, school readiness, art, science and sensory play. Page: https://www.fizzkidz.com.au/preschool-program/
- School science incursions: primary school science incursions in Melbourne with hands-on, curriculum-aligned workshops. Page: https://www.fizzkidz.com.au/in-schools/incursions/
- Kids activations and events: children's entertainment, shopping centre activations, school holiday workshops, corporate family day activities and community event workshops. Page: https://www.fizzkidz.com.au/activations-and-events/
